title: Question
description: One past-paper question (or part) from Edexcel A-level (9MA0) or AS (8MA0) Maths. Unknown values are null, never invented.

question_id.description: PAPER_SERIES_Qpart, e.g. 9MA0-01_2023-06_Q07bii, 9MA0-31_2022-06_Q03a or 8MA0-02_SAM_Q03a. Keep in sync with scripts/naming.py.

generated_id.description: Anchor question id plus -A, -B or -C. Keep in sync with scripts/naming.py.

id.description: Unique id. Its exact pattern is set by each top-level schema.

paper.description: Paper code. 9MA0 = A level (01-03; from 2019 Paper 3 is 31 Statistics + 32 Mechanics), 8MA0 = AS (01-02; from 2019 Paper 2 is 21 Statistics + 22 Mechanics).

series.description: Exam series as YYYY-MM, SAM for sample assessment materials, or SPEC for the specimen set.

question.description: Question label as printed, e.g. "7" or "7(b)(ii)".

spec_ref.description: Specification refs from the entry's own qualification (9MA0 or 8MA0), comma-separated, main ref first, e.g. "8.3, 7.3". validate.py checks them against schemas/topics.json.

mark_scheme.description: Mark points exactly as in the published mark scheme, e.g. "M1: ...". Null if not available.

examiner_notes.description: Comments from the examiner report. Null if none found.

has_diagram.description: true if the question has a figure. Required to be true when question_latex contains a [Figure ...] description.

source_page.description: Page of source_file where the question starts.

source_file.description: The question paper PDF the entry comes from, as named in source/papers/. Usually PAPER_SERIES_QP.pdf for the entry's own paper; for SPEC sections filed under split codes it is the combined paper (e.g. 9MA0-03_SPEC_QP.pdf for 9MA0-31/32 SPEC).
